verdict.rationale: CockroachDB ships its own CLI tooling: `cockroach demo` starts temporary in-memory clusters, single-node mode is documented for quick SQL testing, and `ccloud` creates and manages cloud clusters from the command line. These are plausible building blocks for CI automation, but the evidence never documents headless or non-interactive CI usage, and both `cockroach demo` and `ccloud quickstart` are described as interactive. missing for 10: explicit headless/non-interactive or CI usage docs, non-interactive auth for ccloud in pipelines, CI integration examples, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: A single-node cluster is appropriate for quick SQL testing or app development.
starts a temporary, in-memory CockroachDB cluster of one or more nodes
The `ccloud` tool is a command-line interface (CLI) tool that allows you to create, manage, and connect to CockroachDB Cloud clusters.
